# matim — Claude Code plugin

**Generated by `tools/build_bundles.py`. Do not edit by hand.**
`SKILL.md` and `catalog/` at the repo root are the source of truth.

Installs both halves in one command — the skill that decides which Israeli guide a
question needs, and the connector that fetches it:

```
/plugin marketplace add ilanvys/matim
/plugin install matim@matim
```

The connector points at `https://matim-mcp.vercel.app/api/mcp`. Nothing is stored; skill content is fetched
live from the public skills-il repos. MIT.
